description: The file defines the Proxy class within the OpenCart system, implementing dynamic property handling through magic methods to proxy access to underlying model objects.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: A class that implements a proxy pattern allowing dynamic property access to underlying data, mainly models, via magic methods.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Returns a reference to the data associated with the given key, throws an exception if the key does not exist.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Associates a value with a key in the data array.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the data array.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Removes a key from the data array.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls to the proxy, forwarding them to the underlying data object if it exists, otherwise throws an exception.
